info.title: ResearchCave TSync
info.description: TSync synchronizes independent server and browser localization catalogs with project-wide C#/Razor key analysis and opt-in TypeScript/TSX extraction alongside JavaScript.

options.name: --typescript
options.description: Include .ts, .mts, and .cts files. Declaration files (*.d.ts, *.d.mts, *.d.cts) are excluded by default.

options.name: --tsx
options.description:
Include .tsx files, including translation calls inside JSX expressions and attributes.
Use either or both flags with scan, pot, po, or sync. Default scanning remains JavaScript (.js/.mjs).
Files outside wwwroot require --include globs. Vendor, node_modules, minified, and declaration files are excluded by default.
